title: Dictionary Comprehensions
instructions: Practice creating dictionaries using comprehensions from various data sources, including lists, tuples, and existing dictionaries with transformations.
steps: Create a dictionary mapping numbers to their squares using a comprehension
Convert two parallel lists into a dictionary using comprehension
Transform an existing dictionary by making keys uppercase and doubling values
Create a dictionary from a list of tuples with conditional filtering
Swap keys and values in a dictionary safely handling potential duplicates
